basic_info.description: Bright and Spacious One-Bedroom Loft with Corner Unit Charm. Experience luxury urban living in this stunning one-bedroom, two-bathroom loft, perfectly situated as a corner unit to maximize natural light. With windows on two walls, this loft is bathed in extraordinary sunlight, creating a warm and inviting ambiance throughout the day.    The open-concept living area features concrete flooring on the lower level, adding an industrial-chic touch to the modern design. The sleek kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, elegant countertops, and plenty of storage, making it perfect for both cooking and entertaining.    Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom is a serene retreat, complete with rich wood flooring and en-suite bathroom. A second full bathroom on the main level offers added convenience for guests.    Additional features include in-unit laundry for ultimate convenience and dedicated parking, making city living effortless. This loft is not just a home but a lifestyle, offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and urban convenience.
